description: Azgard Nine Limited is a vertically integrated denim company based in Lahore, incorporated in Pakistan on 20 January 1993 as Indigo Denim Mills Limited, renamed Legler-Nafees Denim Mills Limited in 1994 and taking its present name in April 2004. It describes itself as a composite spinning, weaving, dyeing and stitching unit engaged in the manufacturing and sale of yarn, denim and denim garments. Its own framing of the business is 'engineering the future of denim', carrying a garment from yarn through fabric to retail-ready product.

products.name: Denim fabric
products.summary: High-performance denim and jeans fabrics in rigid, comfort, stretch and bi-stretch weaves, with indigo and dope-dye finishes and recycled and responsible cotton blends.

products.name: Denim garments
products.summary: Ready-to-wear denim and jeans apparel made from the company's own fabrics, from CMT to full package: pattern, sampling, washing, finishing, trims and packing.

products.name: Yarn
products.summary: Open-end and ring yarn spun in-house for denim performance, with up to 80% recycled content in select lines.
